redaction_posture.notes: No customer data, live credentials, network calls, or unredacted machine-local paths were introduced.

scorecard.behavior: Raw outcome input marked as an agent self-report fails before persistence.
Nested source metadata marked as an agent self-report or reflection fails before persistence.
Top-level object_type and event_type markers marked as agent self-reports or reflections fail before persistence.
Canonical experience input marked as an agent reflection fails before distill can write memory rules.
Canonical distill --input records with top-level self-report or reflection markers fail before memory-rule writes.
Generated memory rules identify verified outcome events as the memory source and list self-report/reflection exclusions.
Backtest JSON and HTML reports expose metrics, top repeated mistakes, diagnostics, operator feedback, and badge-ready data derived from canonical experience records.
Backtest command-result metrics count agent-attributed experience records separately from unique agent-attributed PRs.
Backtest --save-baseline reports saved baseline state without carrying stale-baseline diagnostics from the pre-save comparison.
Top repeated mistakes aggregate by the canonical recurrence key when generated signature IDs are reused and later regenerated across the same class/key cluster.
Recurrence report schema_version 1.0 keeps newly emitted T8 metrics, repeated-mistake, diagnostics, feedback, and badge fields optional for backward compatibility.
Interactive backtest output shows operator-visible report summary, top repeated mistakes, report path, diagnostics, and badge text while non-interactive output remains JSON.
README badge fields render stale when source data exceeds 30 days, merged-PR activity exceeds 20 PRs, or merged-PR activity metadata is unavailable.
